svg.title: Host ≠ Peer
svg.desc: Host ordered pipeline: 1 Verify Cap, 2 Consume once / idempotency bind, 3 Dispatch, 4 Record lineage, 5 Project Ops, 6 Return Result. mint is Host privilege. Peer applies Ops only; never mints root Caps; never invents truth.
